descriptionChirho: A part or portion of a whole, including abstract uses such as 'in part' or 'in this respect/matter', and one's allotted share or lot.
A geographical area, district, or region of a land or territory.
A component section or division of something, including a side or constituent part of a larger structure.
One's turn or position in a sequence or rotation of duties.
A physical piece or fragment broken or cut from a larger object.
